title: Reading only the timestamp field of session transcripts with a slice is allowed

fixtures.name: jq timestamp field sliced for the first 16 chars of each transcript

tool_input.command: for f in $(ls -t ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl | head -25); do ts=$(jq -r 'select(.timestamp!=null)|.timestamp' "$f" | head -1); printf '%s %s\n' "${ts:0:16}" "$f"; done
